title: St. Martin of Tours, Bishop
subtitle: Memorial · Ti 3:1-7; Lk 17:11-19
text: As a young Roman soldier at Amiens, Martin cut his cloak in half for a freezing beggar; that night Christ appeared to him wearing the half he had given away. He later became a monk and the bishop of Tours, a father to the poor. On Veterans Day, pray for all who have served and give something warm to someone in need.
imageAlt: A young man in armor on a white horse turns to cut his green cloak with a sword and share it with a nearly naked beggar standing beside him, under a cloudy sky above a distant landscape.
